reference_gaps.expected: parallel block: attention and the MLP both read the layer input, so no residual exists *between* them. The module a resid_mid would be read from is still there -- GPT-NeoX and phi-2 keep `post_attention_layernorm` -- but it is applied to resid_pre, so an engine that hooks it returns resid_pre under this name: vLLM's came back bit-identical to the embeddings before interp-engine refused the point on that backend too. Read resid_pre or resid_post; nnterp still hands one back

run.dtype_note: engines load the checkpoint's native dtype (dtype='auto'); SGLang serves bf16 only (float32 unsupported), so a float32-native model's SGLang cell is a cross-dtype fused case.
